return: Number of ordered outcomes of n dice summing to target, reduced modulo1000000007.
mutation_aliasing: Inputs and caller-held aliases remain unchanged; only private working state is used. The Solution instance retains no state.

complexity: O(n*target*min(k,target)+1) time and O(target+1) live auxiliary space for two rolling rows. All row allocations and modular arithmetic are counted. Bounds include ordinary built-in operations/allocations and assume bounded-word arithmetic, constant-time indexing, amortized append/pop and any explicitly stated hash/sort behavior.
